messages:
Nadia: Heads-up: we need a concise social push for the launch next Tue — X announcement + 3-tweet thread, LinkedIn longform the following day, and a 15s demo clip. Deliverables: 2 hero images, clip trimmed, 2 copy variants, and HubSpot routing. Assets by Mon 5pm PT please.
Ethan: I can do hero images and the clip edit. Which stat should be on-image? Cost or throughput?
Priya: Put cost on the hero ("~40% lower inference cost") and call out 2x throughput in the thread. That hits procurement + eng.
Marco: I'll draft copy A (metric-first) and B (customer story). Keep first line <280 chars for X preview. Also prepare 3 short CTAs for AB.
Nadia: Tracking: utm_campaign=launch_jul, utm_content=A|B. All webinar regs must create HubSpot contact with property "social_series" and field "social_variant". Ops, can you map Segment event -> HubSpot with variant?
ops-bot: Reminder: include key "social_variant" in registration payload. I'll create a test workflow once assets are uploaded.
Ethan: Uploaded drafts: https://files.redwood/launch/heroA.png and heroB.png, demo_v1.mp4. Filenames include variant suffix.
Priya: Draft copy A/B in doc: https://docs.redwood/launch-copy. Variant A metric-first, B narrative. Added UTM placeholders.
Marco: Scheduling proposal: X announcement Tue 9:30am PT, follow-up thread + demo 2h later, LinkedIn longform Wed 10am PT. Buffer scheduling OK?
Nadia: Works. For inbound routing: registrants -> nurture list; attendees -> SDR hot leads + notify #sales-inbound. Add "urgent" flag if company_size>500 or industry contains "security" or "finance".
ops-bot: HubSpot test workflow created (wf_launch_jul). Test lead routed: tag=launch_jul, social_variant=A, owner=SDR-rotation. Webhook to #sales-inbound confirmed.
Ethan: Trimmed clip to 15s, added end-frame CTA, compressed to <12MB for X. Upload: https://files.redwood/launch/demo_v1_trim.mp4.
Priya: Please shorten Variant A first paragraph to ~220 chars for X preview and add UTM shortlink go.red/launchjul?utm_content=A. Also include short alt text for images.
Marco: Adding 3 canned reply templates for engagement: praise, question, demo-invite. Posting them in the doc now.
Nadia: Great. One more: label assets with variant suffix and include metadata in asset folder (variant, creator, final/placeholder). Analytics needs to link CTR -> variant.
Ethan: Done. Filenames: heroA.png, heroB.png, clipA.mp4. Added metadata file.
Priya: Final ask: QA copy + images for accessibility (alt text), ensure links have UTM params. I'll review tonight and approve in Buffer tomorrow morning. Thanks team :rocket:
